scripts.build: go run github.com/google/wire/cmd/wire ./... && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o dist/server . && go run . --dump-openapi openapi.yaml
scripts.generate: go install google.golang.org/protobuf/cmd/protoc-gen-go github.com/google/wire/cmd/wire && export PATH="$PATH:$(go env GOPATH)/bin" && protoc --go_out=proto/gen --go_opt=paths=source_relative --go_opt=Mproto/show/v1/show.proto=tgb-resolver/server-go/proto/gen/show/v1 -I. proto/show/v1/show.proto && mkdir -p proto/gen/show/v1 && mv proto/gen/proto/show/v1/show.pb.go proto/gen/show/v1/show.pb.go && rm -rf proto/gen/proto && wire ./...
